data_gaps.reason: The prospectus states holders may exercise the put right once per interest year if the condition is first met, but does not state a separate annual exercise limit.
The prospectus states shareholders holding the convertible bonds must abstain from voting, but does not state whether bondholders must abstain.
No net asset floor clause is stated on the supplied pages.
No par value floor clause is stated on the supplied pages.
No contract position on below-net-asset issuance is stated on the supplied pages.
The prospectus states the initial conversion price will be determined by the board before issuance and does not state a specific price on the supplied pages.
The conversion period start is described as six months after the issuance completion date, but no specific date is stated on the supplied pages.
The conversion period end is described as the maturity date of the convertible bonds, but no specific maturity date is stated on the supplied pages.
The prospectus states the total raised amount will not exceed RMB 320,000,000, but the final amount is to be determined by the board and no specific issue principal is stated.
No specific issuance date is stated on the supplied pages.
The term is six years from issuance, but no specific issuance date is stated, so the maturity date cannot be determined.
The coupon rate for each interest year is to be determined by the board before issuance; no specific coupon schedule is stated on the supplied pages.
The maturity redemption price is to be determined by the board based on market conditions at issuance; no specific price is stated on the supplied pages.
The prospectus states the company will repay principal and the final year's interest at maturity, but does not state whether the maturity redemption price includes final interest.
The maturity redemption price is to be determined by the board based on market conditions at issuance; no specific rule is stated on the supplied pages.
The prospectus states redemption will occur within five trading days after maturity, but does not state a number of days for a maturity redemption window.
The prospectus states holders may exercise the put right once per interest year if the condition is first met, but does not state a separate annual exercise limit.
The prospectus describes adjustment-day treatment for conversion price adjustments, but does not state a specific adjustment-day treatment for the down revision clause.
The prospectus states shareholders holding the convertible bonds must abstain from voting, but does not state whether bondholders must abstain.
No net asset floor clause is stated on the supplied pages.
No par value floor clause is stated on the supplied pages.
No contract position on below-net-asset issuance is stated on the supplied pages.
